title: Ahwa's South-West Loop. Falls, Valley & Sunset Dam

stops.note: Ahwa's own falls, six kilometres out, the warm-up
The pocket's anchor, with the Vadla ni vadi banyan grove beside it
One kilometre on, the easy double
The one open vista in a closed-forest district
Sunset from the ridge, where the phone signal returns

day_notes.note: A gentle village-roads loop entirely within 20 km of Ahwa, the district's newest-documented pocket. Nothing on the route sells anything: carry the picnic, water and fuel from Ahwa. Everything here is village land; walk field edges, leave the groves as found.

notes: The family-friendliest of the interior days: short walks, a banyan-grove lunch, and a sunset with chai on the dam ridge. Monsoon for the falls; the valley, forest and dam still work into early winter.
